scope: Experimental rigid PhysX GPU measurement. No constitutive or realtime qualification.

performance.timing_scope: Disjoint synchronized wall phases of accepted batches; not GPU kernel timings. Excludes startup, snapshot serialization, IPC, journal and rendering.

qualification.material_scope: Density-derived rigid mass/inertia, numeric global restitution/friction. No bonded fracture/plasticity/elastic/thermal laws. Contact force read is normal-only; friction is not in that ledger.
